description: This file defines the OCIContainer class, which implements plugin and JSONRPC interfaces for managing OCI containers within the WPEFramework plugin architecture. It includes nested Notification class for handling remote connection and container events, and declares methods for initialization, deinitialization, and information retrieval.

classes.name: OCIContainer
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing container management and event notification within the WPEFramework plugin system.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: Nested class handling remote connection notifications and container lifecycle events, used internally by OCIContainer.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the OCIContainer plugin with the provided service shell.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the OCIContainer plugin, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns information about the OCIContainer plugin.
